custom_structure.scope: OpenAPI structure; CEL and actual admission are checked after CRD installation before apply

compatibility.secrets: actual signing/crypto validation occurs at all/run entry before cluster changes; templates validated with isolated test CA

http.tls_model: client-to-gateway TLS termination plus separately verified gateway-to-backend TLS

protocols.scope: dedicated protocol fixtures; database and broker discovery semantics are not inferred from port reachability

ingress.comparison: same backend Host/Path/TLS; standard Ingress does not define the Gateway API weight/header interface

weights.argo_rollouts_adapter: not installed or assumed; these are validated manual route controls
